name: Semaphore
description: Semaphore: two arms held at two of eight angles, spelling one letter per cell.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 47%; top: 6%; width: 6%; height: 44%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(-45deg, 0deg, 45deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(-45deg, 0deg, 45deg, 90deg)); transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 47%; top: 50%; width: 6%; height: 44%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(-90deg, -45deg, 0deg, 45deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(-90deg, -45deg, 0deg, 45deg)); transform-origin: 50% 0; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
